dialogue.instruction: Estás de compras en el mercado del pueblo. Chatea con el Mercader Max y elige la respuesta correcta en cada turno. Tema: compras.

turns.npc: Welcome! What do you want to buy?

options.text: I want to buy a sword.
I want to buy a swords.

turns.npc: Good choice! How many do you need?
Okay! How much is the sword?
It is five emeralds. Here you go!

options.text: Thank you, here is the money.
Thank you, here are the money.
Thank you, here the money is.
